subtasks: Arrange the numbers from left to right to form the largest possible number, and place them on the pad.
Use the left arm to pick up the purple 9 from the center foreground and place it upright on the leftmost wooden pad.
Pick up the purple 7 with the left arm, straighten it upright and place it on the second wooden pad from the left, immediately to the right of the 9.
Pick up the purple 6 at the far left, straighten it upright, and place it centered on the third wooden pad from the left, immediately to the right of the 7.
Recover the dropped purple 6 near the middle of the row. Clear the left arm and use the right arm to place the 6 upright and centered on the third pad, keeping 9 and 7 on their pads.
Place the purple 1 from the left foreground upright and centered on the fourth, rightmost pad. Use the left arm to bring it into right-arm reach if needed. Preserve the placed 9, 7 and 6.
Return both arms to their episode-start poses with both grippers fully open. Leave the upright 9761 arrangement on its pads.
